calls.summary: Meera is preparing for a product designer interview at a fintech startup; nervous about the portfolio round.

turns.text: Next week mera ek bada interview hai, product designer ka. Portfolio round se bahut darr lag raha hai.
Samajh sakti hoon, Meera. Portfolio mein kaunsa project sabse pehle dikhaogi?
Shayad woh payments app redesign. Haan, yaad rakhna, interview ke baad poochna kaisa gaya.
Bilkul, yaad rakhungi. Interview ka din aaye toh main poochungi.

calls.summary: Did a mock interview with Kavya, which went well; she still worries about the case study.
notes: Mentioned Rohit's board exams; ask if she'd like that remembered

turns.text: Kavya ne aaj mera mock interview liya, achha gaya actually!
Wah! Kya sabse achha laga usmein?
Storytelling theek thi, bas case study mein thoda atak gayi.

memories.text: Meera works as a UI designer and is interviewing for a product designer role
Her strongest portfolio project is a payments app redesign
Roommate Kavya helps her with mock interviews
Late-night Maggi is her comfort food before big days
memories.quote: Interview se pehle Maggi toh banti hai

events.text: Mock interview with Kavya went well
